comparison.objective: Screen media from finished washers, versus pulling snapped filament from a 3D-printer extruder.
comparison.physical_skill: Granular pouring and bridge clearing versus accessing, gripping and extracting a thin flexible filament from a feed path.
comparison.success_condition: Mass recovery and washer preservation versus broken filament removed without damaging the extruder.
comparison.reason: The record tests constrained extraction of a flexible strand, not screen-based classification.
